description:
Fetch size-aware order-book fills and estimated taker fees for one Polymarket
    contract and one Kalshi contract, then compare their complete rules. It only names
    a best venue when the pair has been explicitly human-reviewed as equivalent.
    Similar titles with different settlement criteria return `comparable: false` plus
    blockers instead of a fabricated spread or arbitrage. Use this when you already know both ids of one pair; to scan every matched pair use list_executable_opportunities.

amount_usd.description: All-in budget in USD per venue, estimated taker fees included
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

side.description: Outcome to buy on both venues, usually 'Yes' or 'No'
side.title: Side

name: compare_executable_quotes
title: Compare one Polymarket-Kalshi pair, fees included
